change: ModelPlayback::rebind is fallible and rejects authored skeleton changes before replacing its model Arc.
regression: A foreign rig replacement during active transition preserves resource identity and subsequent pose, palette and root displacement relative to an unchanged control.
compatibility: Same authored rig resource replacement remains allowed; original clips and clocks retained. Identical model Arc returns immediately.
scope: Skeleton compatibility boundary; no certification of all other model metadata or GPU resource reloading.
